assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Local facts about the corridor (heritage park phases, Qinghuayuan and Qinghe stations, approved corridor block plan, Wudakou, measurement-point candidates) come from government releases and mainstream news reports registered as SRC-* entries in sources.json; they inform narrative and measurement planning only.
assumptions.impact: These facts never enter the formal evidence layer, do not change provisional geometry or metrics, and are not existing-condition findings; candidate measurement locations await field confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The regional-synergy chapter (Beiwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, E-Town, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei) describes candidate method-exchange interfaces only. The 'three science cities and one area' framing comes from an official page registered as SRC-THREE-CITIES-ONE-ZONE (undated, content circa 2020-2021, background use only); partner naming follows the agent taskbook review dimension.
assumptions.impact: No interface claims existing cooperation, shared data, mutual recognition of results, budgets, or procurement; each requires the counterpart's confirmation, data permission, and written responsibility boundaries before any use, and none alters provisional geometry, metrics, or statutory controls.

assumptions.statement: The eight concept renewal projects P1-P8 carry scale ranges (e.g. point facilities totalling roughly 0.5-1 ha; ground-floor conversions of roughly a thousand sqm) extrapolated from provisional geometry and scenario-card scope, and funding magnitudes stated only as estimate categories (small below million level / medium). Responsible bodies are named by type (district platform company, subdistrict, university team, community organisation), not as specific entities.
assumptions.impact: These values are concept-level magnitudes for feasibility discussion only; they are not budgets, investment commitments, or statutory development scale, and must be replaced by professional estimates after official boundaries, controls, and ownership data arrive.

assumptions.statement: The long-term operating mechanism (Annual Ledger Day, four-season activity calendar, relay path of initiator-maintainer-exit, and the funding-loop mechanism) is a concept proposal. Funding channels are described by category (public innovation, urban renewal) without amounts; sponsorship is restricted to scenarios that have passed G3.
assumptions.impact: No event, organiser, budget, recruitment, or policy is stated as established fact; all require future authorisation, and none alters provisional geometry, metrics, or statutory controls.

assumptions.statement: All unit prices, cost ranges, and labour-cost figures in the P0 demonstrator section (P2 open baseline lab: ROM roughly CNY 2.16-4.25M including 35% contingency; OPEX roughly CNY 0.9-1.5M per year) are participant-set prices. They are not Beijing bid prices, not quotations, and not budget commitments; land, taxes, price escalation, major relocation, and structural or fire-safety works are excluded. Formal estimates, vendor quotes, and a pricing base date are all absent.
assumptions.impact: The ROM and OPEX ranges support order-of-magnitude feasibility discussion only. They do not enter any formal evidence layer, create no funding commitment, and alter no provisional geometry or statutory control.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official pricing basis, vendor quotations, named operator, or owner confirmation arrives; the entire cost model in visual/assets/p0-cost-model.json is then recomputed and the proposal text ranges updated.

assumptions.statement: P0 capacity and staffing parameters are participant-set: 600 sqm open area (about 60% of the roughly thousand-sqm P2 magnitude), 2.5-4 sqm per person (public lab / reading room customary band), 10 opening hours per day, 300 opening days per year, 2 simultaneous posts, 1680 effective hours per FTE, shift-coverage factor 1.2, giving capacity 150-240 persons and 5 FTE after rounding up.
assumptions.impact: Capacity is treated as a ceiling, not a target, and staffing as a precondition of gate G2 rather than a slogan. None of these values is a statutory occupancy figure, a labour commitment, or a measured quantity.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official building data, fire and occupancy review, or an authorised operating plan arrives; capacity and FTE are then recomputed and the proposal text updated.

assumptions.statement: Group-specific acceptance criteria for scenarios 03, 04, 06, 09, and 12 change only the statistical unit of acceptance (per group, never a merged average); they involve no real participants so far. The persona Zheng Lan in the AI Origin section is a synthetic design-test persona, not a real interviewee; this proposal has conducted no resident interviews. The three design flaws she exposes are already corrected in the text, scenario card 03, and the component library.
assumptions.impact: No claim of real participation, co-creation, or observed inclusion outcomes is made anywhere in the package; all group-level field values remain unknown pending authorised baselines.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Authorised co-testing or field baselines arrive; group-level denominators, thresholds, and results are then populated in visual/assets/group-acceptance-contract.json and the coverage metric recomputed.

assumptions.statement: The P0 demonstrator's participant-set unit prices are cross-checked against five public anchors: light-repair plus MEP at 800-1,500 CNY/sqm sits inside the public retrofit band of roughly 700 CNY/sqm (Changying building-body renovation, 2024, including barrier-free and plumbing) to roughly 1,721 CNY/sqm (Tongfang Science Plaza interior retrofit, Haidian, 2026, estimated-contract caliber); barrier-free point works follow the official 0.5-1 wan CNY per-package magnitude (Jingcanfa 2020 No.15 subsidy caps); sensing equipment follows the public procurement unit price of CNY 31,800 per soil-moisture station (Mengcheng 2024, out-of-region magnitude reference); facility operation is bounded above by roughly 230 CNY/sqm/year (fully outsourced property service award, Haidian Wanliu, 2024), with energy, consumables, calibration and insurance carried separately. Anchors raise confidence from unanchored to publicly bounded, but they remain other projects' published calibers, not quotations for this site.
assumptions.impact: Raises the P0 ROM and OPEX ranges from participant-set-only to publicly bounded ranges; the critical-path and professional-estimate confirmation by authorized parties is still pending.
